name: xarevision/nconf
description: NConf: web-based configuration tool for Nagios.

scripts-descriptions.check-syntax: Lint every PHP file outside vendor/ with php -l.
scripts-descriptions.check-sql: Fail when a query is built by pasting a variable into SQL instead of binding it.
scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan (max level, PHP 7.3.4 rules) on the strictly typed files listed in phpstan.neon.
scripts-descriptions.check-php73: Lint the PHP 7.3-compatible code and run the tests under PHP 7.3.4 in a php:7.3.4-cli container (podman or docker).
scripts-descriptions.test: Ensure dev dependencies are installed, then run the PHPUnit test suite.
scripts-descriptions.install-dev: Install all dependencies, including require-dev (dev tooling, tests).
scripts-descriptions.build-prod: Lint-check and SQL-check, then install only production dependencies with a fully optimized, authoritative classmap autoloader.
scripts-descriptions.install-git-hooks: Symlink githooks/pre-commit into .git/hooks/ (run automatically after composer install/update).
